system.creatureSubtype: immune to fire and Negative damage; resistant to cold, lightning (+4 DR
system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Truesight 120 ft, Devil's Sight
system.tactics: A Pit Fiend enters a battle and immediately establishes hierarchy. Infernal Command suppresses any other Fiend present. Fear Presence scatters weaker opponents. It uses Hellfire on grouped enemies and Crushing Fists to control priority targets. A Summoner who has negotiated clearly will find it an extraordinarily capable ally. A Summoner who assumed good faith will find the agreement technically honored in ways they did not intend.
system.attacksNotes:
Crushing Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 10 ft

  • Margin 1:: 20 damage (13 + 7 Str)
  • Margin 2: 20 damage, DR halved (round up); target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or is Grappled
  • Margin 3: 20 damage, DR halved (round up); target Grappled and Restrained (no save).

Hellfire [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120 ft, 20-foot diameter

  • Margin 1:: 20 fire damage (17 + 3 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 20 fire damage, DR halved (round up) + Ignited condition.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Infernal Command: The Pit Fiend can issue commands to any Fiend of lower TR within 300 feet as a [Free] action. Those Fiends must succeed on a Will [Hard] save to refuse. If other Fiends are present on the battlefield from any source, they must make this save or follow the Pit Fiend's orders. Regeneration 10: The Pit Fiend regains 10 HP at the start of its turn unless it took Positive damage this round. Fear Presence: All non-Fiend creatures within 60 feet make a Will [Easy] save at the start of combat. Failure: Frightened for 1 minute. Success: Immune to this Pit Fiend's Fear Presence for 24 hours. Resilient Defense (3/day). When the Pit Fiend fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Binding Contract: Any Pit Fiend that agrees to be summoned expects something in return. This is a GM narrative element, not a mechanical one — but the Pit Fiend will not forget. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
